classification.difficultyReason: Use the central angle to find the sector's fraction of a circle and retain an exact answer.

content.prompt: Find the area of the sector shown opposite. Leave your answer in terms of $\pi$.

spec.description: Unshaded sector with centre O, a horizontal radius to the right and a radius extending upper-left. The included angle is 135 degrees and the horizontal radius is labelled 24 cm. Ordinary source blue outlines and the red centre marker are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: Two equal radii bound a 135-degree sector of a circle of radius 24 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied centre, angle and radius are visible.

answer.worked:
The sector occupies $\frac{135}{360}=\frac38$ of the circle.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{135}{360}\times\pi\times24^2\\A&=\frac38\times576\pi\\A&=216\pi\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
